## Summary

Implemented /api/calendar/feed/[token] endpoint using createServiceClient to resolve feed tokens and call events_for_user RPC, generating RFC 5545 VCALENDAR feeds via ics. Added getCalendarFeedTokenAction and rotateCalendarFeedTokenAction server actions, and built CalendarFeedDialog in the calendar header for feed URL copying and token rotation.

## Decisions

- **Use server-only createServiceClient() to access calendar_feed_tokens and events_for_user**: ICS subscription route is unauthenticated by design and calendar_feed_tokens/events_for_user are restricted to service_role.
